attackers_goals: Attackers may use various methods to execute code in the context of a signed process to avoid detection.
description: A signed process connected to an external domain on a specific port that, on a global level, it usually doesn't connect to.
investigative_actions: Check the destination domain reputation. Check if the actor process loaded a suspicious dll before the alert. Check if the actor process was injected before the alert. Check if the process execution and connections are legitimate.
name: Globally uncommon root-domain port combination from a signed process
